description: Generate an llms.txt document for a site, describing its pages in a form LLMs can consume.

maxUrls.description: Maximum number of site URLs to include in the generated llms.txt.

showFullText.description: When true, include the full text content of pages instead of only summaries in the llms.txt output.

url.description: Base URL of the site to generate an llms.txt document for.

name: firecrawl_generate_llmstxt
